title: Power Pack #5 Marvel Comics 1984 Brigman Early Issue Direct Edition
conditionDescription: Two copies available; both in a similar Very Good range with clean covers and light handling wear. Photos show one of the copies. Please review the photos - they are of the actual copy you will receive.
descriptionText:
Power Pack #5 (December 1984, Marvel Comics) -- early issue of the Louise Simonson / June Brigman series, from the first year of the title. Direct edition. Cover price 60c US.
